The line must go right: the door up is locked until its key is collected; the door left is locked until its key is collected; down is number 3, which comes later.

Contradiction! Every way forward fails: going up leaves no safe move afterwards; going right would force the two-exit cells to link up into a loop (or put the numbers out of order). So my guess (up from cell (3,3)) was wrong, so the line must go right.
I can't rule out up or right yet, so I'll make an educated guess: up.

Going up would leave both cell (1,4) and cell (1,6) needing the line next, and it can't do both; going down would leave number 2 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes right.

Only one free cell next to the line, so it goes left.
